answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade — a bond forfeited on misbehavior. A Sybil attacker must fund each fake identity separately, so the cost follows a spiral upward with every new sock puppet. The stake acts like an opal seal: one honest agent can afford a single bond, but a thousand copies each demand fresh capital, turning a cheap ember of fakery into an expensive blaze. Honest agents earn the bond back; attackers lose it.
